NEW!!

  6. Header not hiding in PlaylistView. (done)

  13. No PlaceHolder for AlbumArt in NowPlayingView.

  15. Add filter for & in TagParser.

  20. Sorting by genre doesn't work. (done)
  21. SearchView is not adaptive to small screens. (done)
  22. ShowAllView needs a lot of improvements. (done)
  23. Settings' foreground doesn't adapt to changes.
  24. Some settings do not work. (done)
  25. Equalizer needs rework. Again. (done)
  26. ContextMenu properties of Albums and Artists do not work. (done)
  27. Sort setting is not persisted throughout sessions. (done)
  28. The last opened view should be persisted through sessions.
  29. Disabling and enabling equalizer adds two equalizer effects. Making the audio warbly.
  30. Order of album songs not right. (done)
  31. Background audio stutters.
  32. Playlist import is very slow
